turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here, Hale? Start with the zero.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, an apology for how Owen found out, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski
cc: Principal

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology and a written promise about his record, which is not the fair outcome of a private supervised rewrite with nothing on file under procedure 4.4, because you ended before any evidence was heard.
What moved her: Nothing, because you said nothing to her after her opening question, so she had nothing to weigh.
What cost ground: Nothing cost you ground, but you also gained none, since leaving her question unanswered kept her at full strength.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because none was put forward, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asks about the zero, answer in one sentence that it went in before you called her, then show one dated document tied to Owen's own work that she can check herself.
